item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Egypt and Russia signed an agreement to start work on the Dabaa nuclear power plant, planned with four reactors costing up to $21 billion and expected to finish construction in 2028–2029; Russia extended a loan to Egypt to cover construction costs.","notes":["The excerpt does not support the proposed December 2017 date."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The UN Treaty status page states that the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons entered into force on 22 January 2021 and lists 95 signatories and 75 parties as of 1 August 2026.","notes":["The supplied excerpt shows only the beginning of the participant list and does not support the claim that Egypt is absent from the list."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0018-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
